stepTitle: The bootstrap distribution shows the variability we might expect in $$\bar{K}-\bar{D}$$ across different random samples of the population.
stepBody:
Using the estimator in part (a), you compute the difference in sample means:
$$\hat{\delta}_{obs}= ar{K}- ar{D}$$
You estimate the variability in $$\hat{\delta}_{obs}$$ by bootstrapping the Kendrick and Drake samples. You record $$ ar{K}- ar{D}$$ for each pair of bootstrap samples. Below is the bootstrap distribution. The null hypothesis is $$\mu_K=\mu_D.$$
Based on the plot, which statements are true?
